propositions: run_git_write does not retry write-side transient faults (ENOENT/EINVAL on loose-object temp-file creation) because _with_transient_head_retry only matches READ-side markers
event_append has a private write-side retry family (_TRANSIENT_ADD_MARKERS and _with_transient_add_retry) that protects git add/commit but no other run_git_write caller inherits this protection

moving the write-side marker family into gitutil's shared seam and renaming the transient retry loop to be fault-generic ensures all run_git_write callers (s3_doctor, compaction, claim/transition writers) inherit bounded retry on write faults
the nested retry composition in event_append inadvertently gives commit paths a 3x3 budget; collapsing to a single _with_transient_fault_retry loop restores the intended bounded 3 attempts
corrupt-object signatures (loose object is corrupt, inflate data stream error) and index.lock contention remain excluded from retry and return immediately on first failure
